defs.def: to record your/sb's/sth's name on an official list 登记；注册

ex.s: The house is now listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
ex.t: 这座房子如今已被列入《国家史迹名录》。

ex.s: A survey found that 29 percent of college students registered for online courses.
ex.t: 我们学会讲真话，即使撒谎对自己有利；我们在不方便的时候也会帮助祖父母。

ex.s: •Once a pair has been determined to be suitable, the students will be contacted individually with a special permission number to register for the programme.
ex.t: •一旦确定一对配对合适，将单独联系学生，提供特殊许可号码用于注册该课程。

ex.s: Signing up for the programme does not automatically mean that you will be able to register and participate.
ex.t: 报名参加该课程并不自动意味着你就能注册并参与。

ex.s: Since there are many factors involved in the pairing process, not all students who sign up will be matched with a partner and be able to register for the programme.
ex.t: 由于配对过程涉及许多因素，并非所有报名的学生都能匹配到伙伴并注册该课程。

ex.s: •Register for a single week or multiple weeks.
How many hours of class will you have altogether if you register for a single week?
ex.t: 如果你报名单周，总共有多少课时？

ex.s: Register online or fill out a Group Play Registration Form with multiple date and start time options.
ex.t: 在线注册或填写团体游玩注册表，提供多个日期和开始时间选项。

ex.s: If a session is full, you can register for the waiting list.
ex.t: 如果课程已满，你可以注册候补名单。

ex.s: Today his hobby has developed into the website postcrossing.com, a social network that has grown to 575,217 registered users in 214 countries and regions since he started it 10 years ago.
ex.t: 如今他的爱好已经发展成为一个网站postcrossing.com这是一个社交网络自他10年前创办以来已在214个国家和地区拥有575,217名注册用户。

ex.s: The beauty of rereading lies in the idea that our bond with the work is based on our present mental register.
ex.t: 是真的，年纪越大，我越觉得时光飞逝。

ex.s: 37   Some people register a list of things they want or need for their new home at a local or store or stores.
ex.t: 人们常放在礼品登记册上的常见物品包括刀具等厨房用具和窗帘之类的东西。

defs.def: to make your opinion known officially or publicly （正式地或公开地）发表意见，提出主张

ex.s: If you forget to officially drop that course, a “F” (Fail) grade will be registered on your record at the end of the term.
ex.t: 那座正在_________修复的木塔很快就会向游客开放，工程即将完工。

defs.def: if a measuring instrument registers an amount or sth registers an amount on a measuring instrument, the instrument shows or records that amount 显示（读数）；记录

ex.s: Last month they registered me for a TV programme, A New You.
ex.t: 上个月他们给我报名了一个电视节目，《全新的你》。

ex.s: Please come to Puma Point, Thursday afternoon or evening, if at all possible, register at the Indian Head Hotel, and call me at 2306.
ex.t: 请来美洲狮角，周四下午或晚上，如果可能的话，在印第安头酒店登记，然后打我电话2306。

ex.s: Secondly, take advantage of opportunities for lifelong learning-for example, you could register online and subscribe to e-learning courses, which have become increasingly popular in recent years.
ex.t: 其次，要利用终身学习的机会——例如，你可以在线注册并订阅电子学习课程，近年来这些课程越来越受欢迎。

defs.def: to show or express a feeling 流露出；显得；表达出
to notice sth and remember it; to be noticed 常用于否定句
to send sth by mail, paying extra money to protect it against loss or damage 把 … 挂号邮寄
an official list or record of names, items, etc; a book that contains such a list 登记表；注册簿；登记簿
the range, or part of a range, of a human voice or a musical instrument 声区；音区

ex.s: They took careful notes and made models of their projects, many of which have survived to this day and are registered as part of UNESCO’s Memory of the World Programme.
ex.t: 他们认真做笔记并制作了项目模型，其中许多保存至今，并被列为联合国教科文组织世界记忆计划的一部分。

defs.def: the level and style of a piece of writing or speech, that is usually appropriate to the situation that it is used in （适合特定场合使用的）语体风格，语域
an opening, with a cover that you can have open or shut, that allows hot or cold air from a heating or cooling system into a room （供暖或制冷设备的）调风口，节气门
